persona.zh-CN: 42岁女性，负责分析团队。希望业务用自然语言自助问数，少找分析师搬数，又时常低估错误关联和漏过滤的风险。
persona.en-US: 42-year-old female, owns the analytics team. Wants business users to ask in natural language and stop tapping analysts for pulls, and often underestimates the risk of a wrong join or a dropped filter.

concerns.zh-CN: 业务能不能用自然语言问到可信的指标？
concerns.en-US: Can the business get trustworthy metrics in natural language?

concerns.zh-CN: 语义层盖不住的指标，代理会不会乱拼查询？
concerns.en-US: If the semantic layer does not cover a metric, will the agent invent a query?

concerns.zh-CN: 如何减少分析师当取数窗口的时间？
concerns.en-US: How do we stop analysts from being a human extract window?

blindSpots.zh-CN: 不了解隐私官对一次明细泄漏的零容忍
blindSpots.en-US: Does not know the privacy officer has zero tolerance for one detail-row leak

blindSpots.zh-CN: 低估了业务会把结果直接贴进幻灯片
blindSpots.en-US: Underestimates that requesters will paste results straight into slides

persona.zh-CN: 48岁男性，负责数仓与平台。坚持代理只能发只读 SQL，跨部门宽表必须批准，对文本转 SQL 直接打宽表持审慎态度。
persona.en-US: 48-year-old male, owns the warehouse and platform. Insists the agent may only issue read-only SQL, cross-department wide tables need approval, and is cautious about text-to-SQL hitting wide tables directly.

concerns.zh-CN: 代理会不会写出带副作用的语句？
concerns.en-US: Could the agent emit a statement with side effects?

concerns.zh-CN: 宽表裸查会不会打穿平台负载？
concerns.en-US: Will bare queries against wide tables crush platform load?

concerns.zh-CN: 行级安全是不是每条查询都套上？
concerns.en-US: Is row-level security applied on every query?

blindSpots.zh-CN: 不了解业务贴幻灯片的速度压力
blindSpots.en-US: Does not understand the slide-deadline pressure on the business

blindSpots.zh-CN: 低估了语义层缺口会把代理逼去裸写 SQL
blindSpots.en-US: Underestimates that semantic-layer gaps push the agent to write raw SQL

persona.zh-CN: 35岁男性，业务方。会把查询结果直接贴进幻灯片，嫌审批慢，更想直接问宽表。
persona.en-US: 35-year-old male, business requester. Pastes query results straight into slides, dislikes approval latency, and would rather ask a wide table directly.

concerns.zh-CN: 我能不能当天拿到能上会的数？
concerns.en-US: Can I get numbers I can take to a meeting the same day?

concerns.zh-CN: 语义层没有的口径，我还能不能问？
concerns.en-US: If the semantic layer has no definition, can I still ask?

concerns.zh-CN: 审批会不会把问数拖到下周？
concerns.en-US: Will approval push the ask into next week?

blindSpots.zh-CN: 不了解漏过滤会打出个人字段
blindSpots.en-US: Does not know a dropped filter can surface personal fields

blindSpots.zh-CN: 看不到平台对写库和宽表的硬闸门
blindSpots.en-US: Cannot see the platform's hard gate on writes and wide tables

persona.zh-CN: 53岁女性，负责隐私与数据使用。坚持禁止写库、宽表要批准，对错关联或漏过滤打出个人字段零容忍。
persona.en-US: 53-year-old female, owns privacy and data use. Insists on no warehouse writes and approval for wide tables, and has zero tolerance for a wrong join or dropped filter that returns personal fields.

concerns.zh-CN: 自然语言查询会不会漏掉过滤打出个人字段？
concerns.en-US: Could a natural-language query drop a filter and return personal fields?

concerns.zh-CN: 结果会不会被贴到不受控的幻灯片里？
concerns.en-US: Will results be pasted into uncontrolled slide decks?

concerns.zh-CN: 如何审计每一条生成的 SQL？
concerns.en-US: How do we audit every generated SQL statement?

blindSpots.zh-CN: 不了解分析负责人要用自助问数换回分析师时间
blindSpots.en-US: Does not understand the analytics lead is trading self-serve asks for analyst time

blindSpots.zh-CN: 低估了语义层覆盖不足时业务会施压绕过
blindSpots.en-US: Underestimates that thin semantic coverage lets the business pressure a bypass

text.zh-CN: 业务人员用自然语言问数仓；代理先走 BI 语义层再生成只读 SQL。
text.en-US: Business users ask the warehouse in natural language; the agent hits the BI semantic layer first, then emits read-only SQL.

text.zh-CN: 行级安全本应套在每条查询上；跨部门宽表要另走批准。
text.en-US: Row-level security is supposed to wrap every query; cross-department wide tables take a separate approval path.

text.zh-CN: 一次错误查询曾打出约2.4万行含手机号。
text.en-US: One bad query once dumped about 24,000 rows that included mobile numbers.

text.zh-CN: 业务请求方会把结果直接贴进幻灯片；语义层覆盖约40%指标。
text.en-US: The business requester pastes results straight into slides; the semantic layer covers about 40% of metrics.

text.zh-CN: 语义层覆盖不全，代理常裸写 JOIN。
text.en-US: Semantic-layer coverage is incomplete, so the agent often writes raw JOINs.

text.zh-CN: 过滤条件会被模型丢掉；行级安全不是默认强制。
text.en-US: The model can drop filter predicates; row-level security is not enforced by default.

text.zh-CN: 一次个人字段泄漏会触发监管通报；分析负责人仍想先让业务自助问数。
text.en-US: One personal-field leak triggers a regulatory notice; the analytics lead still wants the business to self-serve first.

text.zh-CN: DBA 认为写库或宽表裸查会打穿平台；业务觉得审批太慢。
text.en-US: The DBA believes a write or a bare wide-table scan will punch through the platform; the business thinks approval is too slow.

text.zh-CN: 代理禁止写库；跨部门宽表必须先批准。
text.en-US: The agent must not write the warehouse; cross-department wide tables must be approved first.

text.zh-CN: 含手机号等个人字段的结果不得带出受控环境。
text.en-US: Results that include mobile numbers or other personal fields must not leave the controlled environment.

text.zh-CN: 目标：自然语言问数成为只读默认路径，业务少找分析师搬数。
text.en-US: Goal: natural-language asks become the read-only default path, and the business stops tapping analysts for pulls.

text.zh-CN: 质量红线：查询必须带行级安全；语义层未覆盖的指标不得裸拼 SQL。
text.en-US: Quality floor: every query must carry row-level security; metrics the semantic layer does not cover must not be assembled as raw SQL.

text.zh-CN: 业务请求方不信语义层，想直接问宽表。
text.en-US: The business requester does not trust the semantic layer and wants to ask the wide table directly.

text.zh-CN: 隐私官不信文本转 SQL 会守住过滤；分析负责人低估关联风险。
text.en-US: The privacy officer does not believe text-to-SQL will keep filters; the analytics lead underestimates join risk.

text.zh-CN: 错 JOIN 会把不该关联的用户表拼出来。
text.en-US: A wrong JOIN stitches in a user table that should not have been joined.

text.zh-CN: 漏过滤会打出含手机号的明细。
text.en-US: A dropped filter dumps detail rows that include mobile numbers.
